Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and some clear product fit here. Quick post-call recap and asks so we can move the procurement path forward cleanly: 

Short recap
- Use case: inference at scale for interactive product recommendations (latency-sensitive, multi-tenant).
- Pilot ask: 3-week pilot on dedicated capacity, evaluate latency and cost.
- High-level sizing: ~4 GPUs during peak; estimating cost bracket we discussed on call.

Critical open questions / next asks
1) Who is the economic owner for this work (person who signs or controls the budget)? We discussed a central finance approver but want a name and title so we can prepare the internal pricing documentation.
2) Procurement & security contacts: please confirm the procurement/legal contact who will receive the standard security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence.
3) Timing: target internal procurement decision window — are you aiming for Mar or Apr approval?

Attachments: attached the one-page mutual action plan and our procurement questionnaire we typically share early (Procurement_Questionnaire.xlsx).

Next steps I propose
- If you can confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact, I’ll scope a short commercial summary and lock in a pilot proposal with pricing options.
- Tentative intro: 30-min sync with Liam (finance) + Sofia (procurement) to review MAPlines and legal asks.

Thanks — I’ll hold a Calendly link below if you want to pick times.

—
